g.title: Release->ReleaseDate
g.text: Reversed: owner points to weak entity

g.title: ReleaseTableElement->ReleaseTableElement
g.text: Unary: child element points to its parent

g.title: ReleaseTableElement->Series
g.text: No FK in SQL (series_id is text); edge where the Series node exists

g.title: legend
g.text: directed relationship; Neo4j has no cardinality or null markers
catalog relationship / document or lineage relationship
not in graph: Dense vintages stay in SQL; the graph holds the catalog and lineage
not in graph: A series' revision timeline is dense and range-queried, like its vintages; stays in SQL
